summary: The committed serial adversarial suite passes 6 of 11 tests. It exposes a manifest checksum cleanup defect and two non-blocking edge gaps.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: prepareWithManifest compares the SHA-256 text case-sensitively and copies files before checking each digest; valid uppercase hashes fail, while a wrong or space-padded hash leaves a partial public week folder. Green should normalize valid hexadecimal digests, reject malformed values before copying, and remove or atomically withhold partial week output on failure.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] adversarial-testing: manifestToForgeInput accepts traversal, absolute, missing-file, and duplicate rows. copyManifestSubset guards traversal later, so this test did not prove a path escape; reject malformed and duplicate rows at intake and validate referenced files before returning the adapter.

F3 [Nit] adversarial-testing: SoundCard has no wrapping rule for a long unbroken sound word, so text can overflow its fixed bubble box. Add a wrapping rule; shipped week 1-7 text did not trigger this edge.

ADV-P1-1 passed exact start/end edges, overlapping windows, repeated sounds, and parenthesized sung repeats. ADV-P1-2b passed both-cut geometry checks.

ADV-P1-4d confirmed a successful manifest refresh removes stale files. ADV-P1-5 confirmed the approved inset and cast-only rows. ADV-P1-6 confirmed full week 1 output equality with missing, file, and present handoff paths; w04 also fell back to placeholders for a file path.
